# Bolt cheat-sheet (for AI and new developers)
Bolt compiles .bolt files to React + Vite + Tailwind. Indentation (4 spaces) makes blocks.
No imports, no hooks, no router setup. Run `bolt check` after writing, fix every problem, repeat.

## Files
- One page per file, page name = file name: pages/home.bolt holds `page home:`
- Components live in components/. All .bolt files in the project merge automatically.
- layout.bolt: `layout:` wraps every page. `slot` = where the page goes. A page says `layout none` to opt out.
- styles.bolt: `styles:` block of named Tailwind class sets (name: classes). Use names in `styled as:`.
- `use helpers` imports helpers.js / data.json / theme.css by file name from anywhere. Never write paths.

## Pages and components
page home:                       page product(id):   (URL /product/:id)
component ProductCard for product:    (props come from `for`)

## Show things
show "Hello" as title            show product.price as price       show Navbar
show all products                (renders ProductCard for each; matched by name)
row: column: grid 3: card: hero: section: container:   (layout blocks)
button "Save": ...actions...     link "Home" to home               go to product(1)
image product.image              show toast "Saved" as success
... styled as: name-or-tailwind classes (names from styles: expand, md:name works)

## State (no declarations needed for inputs)
store count = 0                  remember theme = "light"          global store cart = []
add product to cart              input "Email" into email          (email is declared for you)
when count changes: ...          if x: ... otherwise: ...          repeat 3 times:

## Data
fetch "/api/products" into products          (default Loading... and error UI included)
fetch url into items:  loading: ...  error err: ...  empty: ...  success: ...   (optional blocks)
submit "/api/x"   update "/api/x/1"   delete "/api/x/1"

## Forms
form:
    input "Email" into email:
        required
        email
    input "Password" into password:
        min 8
    submit "Login":
        show toast "Welcome" as success

## Auth
if logged in: ... otherwise: ...

## Tools
bolt init app | bolt dev app | bolt build app | bolt check [--json] | bolt stats | bolt spec
